functionality.rationale: Multi-file and directory transfers must preserve complete manifest validation, ordering, and partial terminal results.

security.rationale: Every manifest entry, aggregate limit, collision, parent relation, and link must be validated before creation.

performance.rationale: Large manifests and many small files can amplify memory, hashing, traversal, and scheduling costs.

compatibility.rationale: Manifest commitments and ordering must remain byte-compatible with protocol v1 and existing one-file behavior.

concurrency.rationale: Parallel entry processing, partial I/O failure, cancellation, and commit can race within one transfer.

platform.rationale: Name normalization, reserved paths, collisions, directories, and atomic commit vary by filesystem.

persistence.rationale: The task creates and commits multiple durable files and directories with defined partial-failure behavior.

adr.rationale: The task implements accepted protocol v1 manifest and storage contracts without changing them.

architecture.rationale: Multi-file behavior remains within existing native storage and transfer modules.

roadmap.rationale: XT-039 owns production milestone closure after full integration evidence.
